AMPLITUDE_API_KEY.description: Amplitude says API keys are public, because browsers and mobile apps share their code with end users so a key there cannot truly be secret. It can be rotated in place if one is abused. The name is convention.

AMPLITUDE_SECRET_KEY.description: Amplitude says to keep secret keys private and, if one is compromised, to delete it and generate another. There is no rotation in place for this half, and a deleted one cannot be recovered. The name is convention.
